derivation: The revision is the commit that landed these inputs, recorded at the run rather than reconstructed after it. A self-referential pin costs a second commit by construction: a replay's revision must name a tree that already HOLDS its inputs, so the pin can only land after the corpus. Round 942's runbook asked for provenance `exact`; the gate's vocabulary is `derived-upper-bound` and `declared-at-run`, and an unknown value panics — the same correction the map-corpus run had to make against the same word in Round 898's design.
note: Re-checking runs the declared revision against these manifests UNCHANGED. The manifests are the blind authors' output and are never edited to suit a later tool.
